???+ remember "Before you start, remember"

    ??? question "What do we call a name the programmer chose, such as `width` or `Point`?"

        An identifier. It starts with a letter or `_`, continues with letters, digits or `_`, and is case-sensitive.

        Introduced in [2. Basic source rules](02-basic-source-rules.md). Specification: [2. Lexical structure](../specification/lexical-structure.md#23-identifiers).

    ??? question "What do we call a language in which every value has a type known before the program runs?"

        Statically typed. Vortex is statically typed, even when a local variable's type is inferred.

        Introduced in [1. Syntax philosophy](01-syntax-philosophy.md).
